description:
A Beautifully presented and exceptionally spacious two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment situated within the highly regarded Forbes Quay development in the heart of Grand Canal Dock.

From the moment you enter, the apartment has an immediate sense of space and quality. The generous entrance hallway leads into a bright and stylish open-plan living and dining area, creating an impressive central space that is equally suited to relaxing and entertaining. Large windows flood the room with natural light, while the contemporary presentation throughout gives the apartment a sophisticated and welcoming feel.

The separate fitted kitchen is exceptionally practical and well-appointed, with an excellent selection of contemporary wall and floor units, generous preparation space and a full range of modern appliances. Its separate layout allows the main living space to retain a particularly spacious and uncluttered feel.

The accommodation comprises two excellent double bedrooms, both offering generous proportions and comfortable living space. The principal bedroom benefits from a private en-suite bathroom, while the apartment also features a beautifully maintained main bathroom. A separate storage room provides valuable additional storage, an important feature for city-centre living.

Combining generous proportions, two bathrooms, a separate kitchen, excellent storage and a highly desirable south-facing terrace, 73 Forbes Quay offers an outstanding standard of city living in one of Dublin's most sought-after locations.

A particular highlight of this impressive property is the south-facing private terrace. Offering a wonderful outdoor extension to the apartment, it provides an ideal setting for enjoying the sunshine, relaxing after a busy day or entertaining during the warmer months.

Forbes Quay is one of Dublin 2's most desirable residential locations, positioned in the heart of Grand Canal Dock and surrounded by an exceptional selection of cafés, restaurants, bars and everyday amenities. The Docklands' vibrant atmosphere is right on the doorstep, while the city centre is within easy walking distance.

The location is central to  Dublin's principal business districts, with the IFSC, Grand Canal Square and the wider Docklands all within proximity. Trinity College Dublin, Merrion Square, St Stephen's Green, the RDS Arena and Aviva Stadium are also readily accessible.

Transport connections are excellent, with the DART at Grand Canal Dock providing swift access to the city centre and suburbs, complemented by an extensive network of Dublin Bus routes. Dublin Port Tunnel is also conveniently accessible, providing a direct connection towards the M50, Dublin Airport and the wider road network.

The area also offers an excellent selection of supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, fitness facilities and leisure amenities, while the nearby Grand Canal provides a scenic setting for walking and enjoying the surrounding Docklands.

This is a superb opportunity to secure a stylish and exceptionally well-located apartment in the heart of Grand Canal Dock.

Early viewing is highly recommended. Email enquiries only.
